integrity: Proof uses exact chamber Jacobians, binomial convolutions, the Dirichlet exponential representation, and the classical bivariate central limit theorem. Finite exact computations are corroborating checks, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: The CLT concerns squared Euclidean radius in the canonical zero-sum realization; no convergence rate or universality for other metrics is asserted. The equilateral volume was known previously. Unindexed equivalent moment or thin-shell statements may exist; independent scientific verification has not been carried out.
title: Exact isotropic covariance and a Gaussian radial law for equilateral Lipschitz-free balls
